adversarial_checks: Power & TCO invariant check: Confirmed 4.41 W hibernation <= 14.69 W access <= 60 W PSU ceiling, and explicitly caveated that high-capacity 7200 RPM drives draw ~6-10 W more than Synology's 1 TB test drives.
Hardware bottleneck check: Explicitly flagged absence of internal M.2 NVMe slots, 1GbE NIC ceiling (~112 MB/s), and 2 GB default RAM limitation under Docker/Synology Photos.
KR localization & SM-02 check: Verified 100-240V dual voltage + KC certification, KR official benchmark 519,000 KRW vs US $299.99 under msrp_benchmark_mode with asin: null.
